title: Hose Chase
premise: The errand-runner is already wearing the cube. The 4:3 stage is a treadmill. Rubber-hose legs blur into a wheel. The stop is a skid that throws two grooves. The hat stays on.
visual: 4:3 TV stage, cream cyclorama, orange curtain legs, muted checkerboard floor. Cream sphere head, orange sphere body, black hose limbs, two dot eyes, blue TV-paint cube as a hat. Locked side-on. Not photoreal, not 2D paper cel — 3D puppets at Saturday-morning speed.
motion: 0–2s: squash-in, already hatted. 2–12s: locked chase, repeating floor and curtains, legs as a four-spoke wheel, three afterimage ghosts. 12–16s: stretch-skid, dust cloud, two smoking grooves, cap-hat wobbles and settles. Camera locked. Loop from the empty treadmill.
